tl0001.name: Archivist Mara
tl0001.line: Dorian's last travel ledger is in the library. The court holds the key to his western route.

tl0001.name: King Edmon
tl0001.line: I am Alsperia's original king. I grant you a map and shelter; return with knowledge, not conquest.

tl0001.name: Queen Alisande
tl0001.line: Edmon is my husband and king. His trust opens this road, and I expect you to honor it.

tl0002.name: Scout Tessa
tl0002.line: Pale stones mark the safe ground. The moss hides old snares, so watch where you step.

tl0002.name: Lost Wayfarer
tl0002.line: Something circles the ruined watchpost. I heard it answer my name from the trees.

tl0003.name: Dorian the Seer
tl0003.line: I hid the scrolls because a road between worlds magnifies the purpose of whoever crosses it.

tl0003.name: Lorian Guardian
tl0003.line: The vault is not a prize. Prove you can leave its door closed before you ask it to open.

tl0004.name: King Edmon
tl0004.line: You have returned with the scrolls. Tell the court what they can do, and what they must not do.

tl0004.name: Queen Alisande
tl0004.line: Knowledge won in darkness deserves careful study. I will argue for patience before the nobles.

tl0005.name: Magister Vael
tl0005.line: The observatory wards bend toward the breach. The sealed lecture vault is answering voices from below.

tl0005.name: Queen Alisande
tl0005.line: I will hold the wardens at the perimeter. Do not mistake the echo for a command.

tl0006.name: Ealdrin
tl0006.line: This living record says a Tear may answer a powerful mind that questions its own limits.

tl0006.name: Queen Alisande
tl0006.line: We need scholars and warders before we follow the second Tear. I will not leave the record unread.

tl0007.name: Queen Vaelthira
tl0007.line: My sanctuary's Tear speaks with a familiar voice. I ask you to study it before choosing what to do.

tl0007.name: Seraphina Everglow
tl0007.line: The ward diagrams are ready. We can observe the Tear without provoking it.
